brief.headline: Memory supercycle intact—DRAM +63% QoQ Q2, HBM shortages through 2027, SK Hynix market cap closes within 5% of Samsung
brief.summary: <cite index="15-2,15-7">DRAM contract prices jumped 58-63% QoQ in Q2 2026 following a 90-95% surge in Q1, while NAND rose 70-75% QoQ</cite>, driven by <cite index="10-3,10-4">server demand and capacity reallocation toward HBM, constraining supply to other applications</cite>. <cite index="7-2,7-3">Samsung's semiconductor division posted 53.7 trillion won operating profit in Q1 2026 (94% of total), while SK Hynix reported 52.6 trillion won revenue and 37.6 trillion won operating profit on booming HBM sales</cite>. <cite index="20-6,22-3">Hyperscalers plan $660-725 billion in 2026 capex, with ~75% directed to AI infrastructure</cite>, sustaining memory tightness. <cite index="28-4,28-6">TSMC's CoWoS supply-demand gap is narrowing from 20% to 10% by end-2026 as monthly capacity reaches 120,000-140,000 wafers</cite>.
brief.pair_trade_view: Long SK Hynix / Short Samsung. <cite index="39-6,39-13,39-14">SK Hynix closed at 1,969.9 trillion won market cap (95.2% of Samsung's 2,069.6 trillion won common stock cap), narrowing the gap to ~100 trillion won</cite>. <cite index="45-7,45-9">Foreign investors net bought 3.1 trillion won of SK Hynix over 4 consecutive days, concentrating solely on SK Hynix while Samsung absent from top-20 net buys</cite>. <cite index="3-5,3-12">SK Hynix positioned as primary anchor of HBM-led supercycle with HBM3E and HBM4 reliability; BofA named it global memory 'Top Pick'</cite>. <cite index="8-1,8-2">Samsung shipped HBM4E samples (12-layer, 20%+ faster than HBM4)</cite>, but timing lags SK Hynix's volume ramp. Pure-play memory exposure favors SK Hynix in this cycle.

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="3-11">BofA forecasts global DRAM revenue +51% YoY, NAND +45% YoY in 2026, with ASPs up 33% and 26% respectively, defining it as a '1990s-style supercycle'</cite>. <cite index="4-1">Goldman Sachs forecasts 4.9% DRAM supply deficit in 2026</cite>. <cite index="7-6,7-13">Analysts view this cycle as different from historical swings, with AI infrastructure consuming hardware at unprecedented rates</cite>. Pricing power intact through at least H2 2026; new fab capacity (Samsung P5 2028, SK Hynix M15X mid-2027) deferred.

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="1-3">Samsung expanding HBM production capacity ~50% in 2026; SK Hynix increasing infrastructure investment 4x prior guidance</cite>. <cite index="7-2,7-3">HBM sales fueled SK Hynix to 37.6 trillion won Q1 operating profit</cite>. <cite index="1-7">Memory shortage from AI datacenter build-outs could last up to two years</cite>. <cite index="6-3,6-6">Intel/SoftBank ZAM memory promises 2-3x HBM3 bandwidth at lower cost/energy, threatening HBM oligopoly post-commercialization</cite>. <cite index="5-14">Global memory shortage enables Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron to hike prices</cite>. Watch for Nvidia HBM4 qualification timing—Samsung disclosed discussions, SK Hynix leading.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix market cap hits 2,000 trillion won intraday, closes at 95% of Samsung's common stock cap
news_pulse.implication: Structural shift in Korean equity leadership; SK Hynix pure-play HBM exposure outperforming Samsung's diversified model. Momentum may trigger passive rebalancing and derivatives hedging flows.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM contract prices +58-63% QoQ Q2, NAND +70-75% following Q1's 90-95% DRAM surge
news_pulse.implication: NAND now outpacing DRAM price growth for first time in cycle; enterprise SSD tightness from AI deployments. Validates memory supercycle thesis; incremental upside to Samsung/SK Hynix ASP/margin guidance.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex revised to $660-725 billion, 75% AI infrastructure
news_pulse.implication: Meta raised 2026 capex to $125-145bn citing higher component pricing. Demand backstop for HBM/server DRAM through 2027; cloud backlog (AWS $244bn, Microsoft Azure $80bn unfulfilled) confirms supply constraints.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS supply gap narrowing from 20% to 10% by end-2026; capacity hitting 120-140k wafers/month
news_pulse.implication: Easing packaging bottleneck unlocks incremental HBM demand for Samsung/SK Hynix. Nvidia holds 60% of CoWoS allocation through 2026; AMD/Broadcom absorb remainder. Positive read-through for memory attach rates.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung ships HBM4E samples (12-layer, 20%+ faster than HBM4) using 1c DRAM process
news_pulse.implication: Samsung advancing on next-gen HBM, but sample stage vs. SK Hynix volume production. Timing critical for Nvidia Rubin platform wins. Technology parity closing but execution gap remains.

news_pulse.headline: Foreign investors net bought 3.1 trillion won SK Hynix over 4 days; Samsung absent from top-20 buys
news_pulse.implication: Concentrated thematic bet on AI memory vs. Samsung's conglomerate discount. Flow suggests institutions rotating into pure-play exposure ahead of H2 earnings. Positioning skew creates downside volatility risk if HBM mix disappoints.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix labeled 'meme stocks' by Bloomberg columnist amid retail frenzy
news_pulse.implication: Retail participation and derivatives activity elevated; valuation discipline eroding. Near-term pullback risk if profit-taking accelerates. Monitor Korea leverage loan tightening (per global banks).

news_pulse.headline: Intel/SoftBank ZAM memory claims 2-3x HBM3 bandwidth at lower cost; VLSI symposium presentation June 14-18
news_pulse.implication: Long-term disruptive threat to HBM oligopoly if commercialized (2029 target). Current cycle pricing unaffected, but strategic risk to Samsung/SK Hynix post-2027 if ZAM scales. Monitor Intel/SoftBank partnership progress.

brief.derivatives_signal: <cite index="37-4,37-5,37-8,37-17">Pre-market NXT up 2.35%; Samsung +4.83% to 380,000 won (all-time high), SK Hynix +4.54% to 2.807 million won</cite> following Philadelphia Semiconductor Index +6% close. <cite index="39-7">SK Hynix hit intraday high 2.891 million won, breaching 2,000 trillion won market cap intraday</cite>. Implied volatility likely elevated; watch for profit-taking into cash open given 'meme stock' characterization. KOSPI 200 futures strength supports near-term momentum, but retail crowding and leverage loan tightening (per Bloomberg) flag reversal risk.
watch_for_next_3h: Samsung/SK Hynix cash open follow-through vs. pre-market gains—test of 380k/2.8m levels and retail profit-taking behavior
Korea Exchange position disclosures on foreign/institutional flow continuation; any rotation back to Samsung would signal pair-trade unwind
TSMC CoPoS equipment qualification timeline updates (June 2026 target per Commercial Times)—impacts 2027-28 HBM/CoWoS roadmap
Hyperscaler Q2 earnings commentary (July) on memory procurement costs and HBM allocation; Meta's component pricing increase already telegraphed margin pressure
